dataset.title: H2O2 induced oxidative stress may trigger cellular senescence in retinal photoreceptor cells through modulation of ECM-receptor interaction, oxidative phosphorylation and spliceosome pathways

findings.message: The bundle holds 306209 where the producer reported 306232 (results.txt: All target PSMs with q-value <= 0.01 (pxreprise:DEF-PSM-1PCT v1)). Both numbers are kept; treat the producer's as canonical until the difference is explained.

306 of the 510 channels of the search's TmtDesign.txt have no row of the SDRF naming their file and label, so their assays sit on the design's own sample (its `Sample Name`), with nothing known about it. E.g. `PXD037329:661W_TMT1_10:TMT126`, `PXD037329:661W_TMT1_10:TMT127C`, `PXD037329:661W_TMT1_10:TMT127N` and 507 more.

The deposited SDRF describes its samples only as text with no ontology term, so the curated organism part, cell type, disease and individual columns are empty. The text is in sample_characteristics: cell type: photoreceptor cell. Match on it as text; it has not been mapped to a term.

Some modifications on peptides shared between proteins were not written to ptm_sites for one or more of those proteins, because the peptide could not be located in that protein's sequence and the producer's residue spans cannot be paired with its accessions. Of the (PSM, protein) pairs affected: 3486 named a protein that does not contain the stored peptide -- typically a PSM ambiguous between peptide sequences (level 4 or 5), where this protein carries a different candidate than the first, which is the one stored. Sites on the other proteins of the same PSMs are written. Counts are in bundle.json under protein_databases.

1 modification(s) could not be mapped to a UNIMOD accession or a mass, and are carried in ProForma as [Info:...] tags: UniProt:S-(15-deoxy-Delta12,14-prostaglandin J2-9-yl)cysteine on C. Their ptm_sites rows exist and carry modification_name, with modification null, so a query by name finds them and a query by UNIMOD accession will not.

306 channel(s) of the search's TmtDesign.txt are not study samples: `Sample Type` empty: `PXD037329:661W_TMT1_10:TMT128C`, `PXD037329:661W_TMT1_10:TMT129C`, `PXD037329:661W_TMT1_10:TMT129N`, `PXD037329:661W_TMT1_10:TMT130C`, `PXD037329:661W_TMT1_10:TMT130N` and 301 more. Their values measure that reference, not a sample of the question. The design is copied in `sources/`, and each assay keeps its `Sample Type` (`assays.design_sample_type`). A channel marked `empty` had no sample put in it: unless the SDRF names one for it, its assay has no `sample_id`, and its values are kept as measured (isotope spill-over from a neighbouring channel, PXReprise 098), so a count of samples never counts it and a median across a run's channels must leave it out.

PTM site occupancy was not stored: this is a TMT dataset, and MetaMorpheus computes intensity occupancy for label-free searches only; its count occupancy is per file, repeated on every channel (QuantProject DEF-OCC-INT). `ptm_stoichiometry` has no rows here because of that, not because no site was modified.

No per-run `metrics` row from results.txt for `psms_1pct` (51 of 51 runs), `peptides` (51 of 51 runs), `protein_groups` (51 of 51 runs). These counts were not written, which is not a count of zero. The search task sets `WriteIndividualFiles = false`, and MetaMorpheus writes results.txt's per-file PSM, peptide and protein-group lines only when it is true (before 1.1.14, MetaMorpheus #2955, its per-file precursor and MS2 lines too). PXReprise's QC payload counts each run's share of the whole search's 1% set instead, a different number (the FDR is the whole search's, not recomputed on each file), under names of its own (`source = 'qc_payload.json'`): `psms_1pct_whole_search` for 51 of the 51 runs, `peptides_1pct_whole_search` for 51 of the 51 runs, `protein_groups_1pct_whole_search` for 51 of the 51 runs.

dataset.summary: PXD037329 is a DDA isobaric dataset (Mus musculus) with 51 runs, 12 samples and no enrichment step (whole proteome). It was reanalysed with MetaMorpheus 1.1.14. At 1% FDR the search reports 306,209 PSMs and 6,262 protein groups; 59,740 peptidoforms pass 1% on its q-value and notch q-value, and the repository holds 119,569 PTM sites for it. 6 open warnings about it are recorded.

organisms_are: `organisms` is the organism of the protein DATABASE the search used, not a statement about the samples. Sample annotation, where any exists, is in the catalog's `samples` and `sample_characteristics` tables.
